intro: YouTube is tricky because picture and audio travel as separate adaptive streams, so the highest quality often has no single merged file. HJ Video Downloader picks the best video and best audio streams server-side and merges them into one complete MP4, saving you that step entirely.

Beyond regular uploads, Shorts, list-parameter playlists and past live broadcasts all work. If you only want the sound, switch to MP3 and get an audio file — ideal for live music, talks and long podcasts.

faq.q: How do I fix "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"?
faq.a: That is YouTube's anti-bot check. Placing a Netscape-format cookies.txt on the server (default file name cookies.txt) and retrying raises the success rate substantially.
